recent.text: Neither Quickley or Barrett are lacking for self awareness. I'm sure they know last night was, uh, not their best. Credit to them for that bounce-back half. 28 combined points on 16 shots, but also making a concerted effort to keep the ball moving, which was the issue vs Boston.
recent.author: Josh Lewenberg

recent.text: In the span of 4 games, Alijah Martin went from a 22% career 3-point shooter to a 40% career 3-point shooter. First 30 NBA games: 6-for-27 Last 3.5 games: 11-for-16
recent.author: Josh Lewenberg
recent.quoted_text: After starting his NBA career 6-for-27 from 3, Martin went 6-for-7 on Friday. "I've been waiting on that, honestly. I know what type of shooter I am but I haven't been able to showcase it the way I wanted to. It was very rewarding." He shot 42% on 5.6 3PA in G League last season

recent.text: This is the version of RJ Barrett that the Raptors need without Barnes/Leonard: quick and decisive with his reads. He didn't have an assist until the 2nd half vs Memphis and finished with 2 in 36 minutes. He's got 4 in 7 minutes so far tonight.
